name: New Bark Town & Elm's Pokémon Laboratory
summary: Step into historic New Bark Town, the tranquil settlement where winds of a new beginning blow. Enter Professor Elm's research laboratory. Impressed by your 11 League Badges, Elm celebrates your journey by offering your choice of a classic Gen 2 Johto Starter—Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile—at Level 5. In addition, Elm presents you with HM05 Waterfall, granting you the capability to ascend thunderous cascades across Johto and Kanto.

items.name: HM05 Waterfall
items.method: Gifted by Professor Elm inside his New Bark Town lab after earning Johto Badges

items.name: Elm's Johto Starter (Chikorita / Cyndaquil / Totodile)
items.method: Gifted by Professor Elm from the research counter; choose one of the three Level 5 starters

items.name: Everstone
items.method: Gifted by Elm's lab assistant after showing a successfully hatched Pokémon egg

items.name: Potion
items.method: Found on the shoreline path leading toward Route 27
